# Vendor template provenance

Files `IEEEtaes.cls` and `IEEEtaes.bst` are the official original-research
templates (class header `IEEEtaes.cls 2022/02/15 version V1.1`). They were
extracted from that source and then mechanically normalized by removing only
trailing spaces and tabs. No executable, macro, bibliography-style, or prose
content was changed. This normalization keeps repository-wide
`git diff --check` meaningful; it is not a template-semantic exemption.

SHA-256 of the normalized files is recorded by the manuscript source-closure
hash (relative paths), along with every other build input.
